svg.aria-label: Filling, cover sheet and curing: slightly overfill the hole of the ring spacer with precursor, then lay a UV-transparent quartz plate or PET film on the ring and press so the excess squeezes out. In the glovebox, cure through the cover sheet with 365 nm UV, then peel off the cover sheet and place the spacer.
